description.default: Aggregate task lists scattered across documents into one unified panel: scope by doc / path / notebook, filter by status, group by document and heading tree, sort tasks of the same list by completion, check off and jump back to source.
description.zh_CN: 将分散在不同文档中的任务列表汇集为一个统一面板：按当前文档/指定路径/笔记本设定范围，按完成状态筛选，按文档与标题树归类，同一列表块内按完成状态排序显示，支持勾选写回与跳转源块。
